description: This file is a C header file defining functions for parsing device descriptors and blacklisted UUIDs, typically used in device configuration or filtering features within a larger project.

methods.name: parseDeviceDescriptors
methods.description: Parses a device descriptor list from specified whitelist and blacklist file paths, returning a list of device descriptors that are not blacklisted.

methods.name: getBlacklistedUuids
methods.description: Parses a blacklist file to retrieve a list of blacklisted UUIDs for devices.
